text: Fisher–KPP侵入前線 Fisher–KPP invasion front Fisher–KPP侵入前線 u_t=D\Delta u+ru(1-u) 0\leq u\leq1 拡散と増殖を結ぶ侵入前線。表示は規格化した代表形で、波の速度と境界条件は解説先へ。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Fisher–KPP：特殊波速の厳密前線 Fisher–KPP invasion front u_t=D\Delta u+ru(1-u) 0\leq u\leq1 Spatial spread of an invading population or advantageous allele, represented by a reaction–diffusion front. Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed.
